The '''Caravanserai Farmers Bazaar''' is one of four orcish workshops used for trade. Farm products can be bought or sold here in exchange for coins. Copper coins may be exchanged for silver or silver coins for gold using 5,000 coins at a 25:5:2 rate.

== Sold ==
* [[cv:Fish|Fish]] (10 fish for 2,500 copper coins)
* [[cv:Meat|Meat]] (10 meat for 2,500 copper coins)
* [[cv:Plants|Plants]] (10 plants for 500 silver coins)
* [[cv:Alchohol|Alcohol]] (1,000 silver coins per barrel)

== Bought ==
* Crate of [[fungi]] logs (1,000 silver coins)
* [[Wicker]] bales (2,500 copper coins)
* Common spore packet (1,000 silver coins)
:* 5 plump helmet spores
:* 50% chance of 5 pig tail seeds
:* 50% chance of 5 cave wheat seeds
:* 50% chance of 5 sweet pod seeds
* Common seed packet (1,000 silver coins)
:* 5 fisher berry seeds
:* 50% chance of prickle berry seeds
:* 50% chance of wild strawberry seeds
:* 50% chance of rope reed seeds
* Dye seed packets (1,000 silver coins)
:* 5 blade weed seeds
:* 50% chance of dimple cup seeds
:* 50% chance of hide root seeds
* Boreal seed packets (2,000 gold coins)
:* 5 taiga pear seeds
:* 50% chance of 5 icicle mint seeds
:* 50% chance of 5 winter bloodberry seeds
:* 50% chance of 5 boreal tuber seeds
* Poisoner plants (1,000 platinum coins)
:* 5 bitterroots
:* 50% chance of 5 zombie flowers
:* 50% chance of 5 shadowleaf bushes
:* 50% chance of 5 kobold bulbs
* 4 [[cv:Potash|potash]] (1,000 copper coins)
* 4 [[cv:Gypsum|gypsum]] (1,000 silver coins)
* [[Underdark Nethermill]] plans (5,000 gold coins)
